note: Hand-written from the Google Drive API reference for files.create and for the uploadType=media upload, which the client chains: it POSTs the metadata, then PATCHes the bytes to the upload host. Both answers carry the default field set Drive returns when no `fields` mask is sent (kind, id, name, mimeType), and both are written here identically because that is what Drive answers; what this fixture measures is that the operation makes exactly those two calls and that the second answer is parsed through serde_json::from_slice on the capped bytes rather than through the JSON helper, a path no other fixture reaches. Not a recording.
